answer: Costly admission with replayable challenges: each new identity must post a bond and answer a fresh, unguessable prompt; a copied or rehearsed answer burns the bond and demotes the sponsor. Scaling to N fakes costs N bonds and N distinct texts, and the relic of every caught copy stays public and replayable. The zenith of honest standing compounds across epochs, while the reef of each bad vouch is hard to forge, so mass registration stays unprofitable.
